title: 第9章 桀桀桀桀第10章 入宫
lines: 翌日。
大清早，白羽洗漱完毕起床吃早饭。
也没出去吃，就在客栈里面。
这里鱼龙混杂，能听到更多消息。
“最近北方闹灾，听说有一个什么天通道人当着数十万人的面召唤雷霆，他召集那些泥腿子反抗朝廷，据说已经打下一府之地。”
“哇啊，召唤雷霆，莫不是仙人下凡？”
“谁知道呢，据说连一些武林高手都前去投靠，是不是仙人不好说，但有些本事在身是肯定的。”
“了不得，那朝廷方面怎么说？”
“吵得不可开交，还是丞相力排众议决定从其他地方调兵去剿灭。”
“怕是不成哦，我听其他来往商队所说，如今土匪遍布，说不得一从其他地方调兵，那些个土匪又有人杀出来了……”
高论，白羽听得暗暗点头。
世道乱了，这些土匪之中说不好就有未来争天下之人。
天通道人做出头鸟，实际也是给了其他人发育时间。
一如元朝末年一般，朱元璋不就是在养蛊一般的模式中杀出重围么。
可惜了，就算这里有朱元璋这种人物，等到他威胁京城安危之际，一股神秘力量就会降临将之磨灭。
“世道乱了，恐怕是没几年安生日子，届时行商恐怕都不稳妥。”
“嘿～，这关我们什么事儿，你我只管在这京城花花世界快活就是了。
古往今来，又有哪个叛贼能杀到京城来？”
“这倒也是，哈哈哈哈，吃吃吃，吃完咱们就去踏青游玩一番……”
这便是京城里的现状，但凡有些经济条件的根本不慌，只管沉浸在酒池肉林之中。
赵国还是丞相制，这种将一切丢在皇帝和丞相身上的制度实在是太糟糕了。
现在就是这么个情况，皇帝和丞相都是烂人，只管享乐根本不管民事，百官也上行下效。
当然，白羽也只是感慨而已，反正这一切都不关自己的事，自己只是来看看这个皇朝千年积累。
希望不会失望。
吃过早饭，白羽叫来小二结账。
一掏钱袋子，发现结完账了竟然没剩几个子了。
眼珠子提溜转一圈，白羽转头看向刚才闲聊那几位。
嗯。
是时候劫他人富济自己的贫了。
一个时辰后，白羽腰包鼓鼓的走出一条巷子。
巷子里传出杀猪般的叫声，顿时引来围观群众强势围观。
哼着小曲，白羽一路来到皇城下边。
content_en:
The next day.
Early in the morning, Bai Yu finished washing and got up to have breakfast.
I didn’t go out to eat either, just in the inn.
It's a mixed bag here, and you can hear more news.
"There has been a disaster in the north recently. I heard that a certain Heavenly Passage man summoned thunder in front of hundreds of thousands of people. He summoned those mud-legged people to resist the imperial court. It is said that he has conquered a palace."
"Wow, summoning thunder, could it be that an immortal descended to earth?"
"Who knows, it is said that even some martial arts masters have come to seek refuge. It is hard to say whether they are immortals, but I am sure that they have some abilities."
"It's amazing, what does the court say?"
"There was such a quarrel that the prime minister decided against all the opinions to send troops from other places to annihilate them."
"I'm afraid it won't work. I heard from other caravans that there are bandits all over the place now. I wonder if the bandits will be killed again if we mobilize troops from other places..."
After hearing this, Bai Yu nodded secretly.
The world is in chaos, and among these bandits there may be those who will fight for the world in the future.
The people from Tiandao are the first to take the lead, which actually gives others time to develop.
Just like in the last years of the Yuan Dynasty, Zhu Yuanzhang fought his way out of the siege in the general mode of raising gu.
It's a pity that even if there is a figure like Zhu Yuanzhang here, when he threatens the safety of the capital, a mysterious force will come and wipe him out.
"The world is in chaos. I'm afraid we won't be able to live a peaceful life for a few years. By then, I'm afraid it won't be safe to do business."
"Hey~, it's none of our business, you and I just want to be happy in this colorful world in the capital.
In the past and present, which traitor has been able to come to the capital? "
"That's true, hahahaha, eat, eat, eat. After eating, let's go for an outing..."
This is the current situation in the capital. As long as there are some financial conditions, don't panic at all and just immerse yourself in the wine pool and the meat forest.
Zhao State still has a system of prime ministers. This system that leaves everything on the emperor and prime ministers is really terrible.
This is the situation now. The emperor and the prime minister are both bad people. They only care about enjoying themselves and don't care about civil affairs. The officials also follow the instructions.
Of course, Bai Yu was just sighing. Anyway, all this was none of his business. He just came to see what this dynasty had accumulated over the past thousand years.
Hope you won't be disappointed.
After breakfast, Bai Yu called the waiter to pay the bill.
When I took out my money bag, I found that after paying the bill, there were not many coins left.
His eyes rolled around, and Bai Yu turned to look at the people who were chatting just now.
Um.
It’s time to rob others from their wealth and give to your own poverty.
An hour later, Bai Yu walked out of an alley with a bulging pocket.
"Ah~!"
A sound like a slaughtering pig came from the alley, which immediately attracted a strong crowd of onlookers.
Humming a little tune, Bai Yu came all the way to the bottom of the imperial city.
